due_when.clears_when: A 110001 on a leg the same run already removed via its paired sibling is classified as already_gone rather than failed, so a run that reaches its intended post-state reports success. The states stay separate: already_gone (we removed it via its pair) must not be merged into cancelled (we cancelled it directly) nor into failed (the venue refused). A test asserts a run whose targets all return 110001 after their stops cancelled OK does not report partial_cancel.
